title: Make flags a first-class, filterable tag axis
lead:
Items already carry a multi-valued `flags` list, but flags are write-only: they
can be set (`set --flag`) and can hide an item at render (`exclude_flags` in
config), yet there is no way to *query* by them. The single-valued `pass` and the
subsystem-oriented `trees` cover milestones and code areas; neither gives
orthogonal, free-form labels like `security`, `perf`, or `v1.0.0`. This slice
turns the existing `flags` field into a real, queryable tag axis without adding a
new field.
boundary:
**Not in this slice:** renaming `flags` to `tags` (the field name stays for
compatibility; this is a query surface, not a schema change); a dedicated
`tag`/`untag` command (use `set --flag`); flag-scoped rendering sections.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
A milestone lives in one `pass` and an item belongs to specific `trees`, but
sometimes you want cross-cutting labels an item can hold several of at once, and
you want to filter by them. Flags are already the right data shape (a list); they
just lack a query surface. Promoting them to a filterable axis gives free-form
tagging with no new schema.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/cli.py` — a `list --flag` filter (repeatable, matching the existing
  `--tree`/`--status` filters); consider `find`/`stats` coverage
- `src/slicer/tui.py` — add `flag` to `FILTER_GROUPS` and `filter_choices` so the
  `f` filter panel offers flags like it offers tree/pass/importance
- `src/slicer/graph.py` or wherever list filtering resolves, if shared
- `docs/agents.md`, `docs/getting-started.md`, `README.md` — document flags as a
  tag axis and the new filter
- `tests/test_cli.py`, `tests/test_tui.py`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `list --flag security` returns only items whose `flags` contain `security`;
   repeatable `--flag` is OR within the group, matching `--tree` semantics.
2. The TUI filter panel lists each distinct flag and filters the queue by it.
3. `exclude_flags` render behavior is unchanged.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Add a `--flag` filter to `list` mirroring `--tree` (repeatable, OR within group,
AND across groups). Add `flag` to the TUI `FILTER_GROUPS` and `filter_choices`
(each distinct flag, plus the "(none)" case), reusing the existing `Filters`
machinery. Keep `set --flag` and `exclude_flags` exactly as they are. Document
flags as the orthogonal, multi-valued tag axis alongside `pass` (milestone) and
`trees` (subsystem).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
You can label items with free-form flags and then answer "show me everything
tagged X" from both the CLI (`list --flag X`) and the TUI filter panel; existing
flag/exclude behavior is untouched.
